in_marathi.name: Rupamati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Beauty of form
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rupamati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'beauty of form'. In Hindu mythology, Rupamati is associated with the goddess of beauty and prosperity, Lakshmi.

in_bengali.name: Rupamati
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Beauty of form
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rupamati একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'beauty of form'. In Hindu mythology, Rupamati is associated with the goddess of beauty and prosperity, Lakshmi.
